dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "I'm looking for a visitor from Fontaine who was asking about hot springs on the Visitors' Message Board — the one who mentioned something about 'melting,' or 'dissolving.'"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "I originally invited him to join me on a trip to an outdoor hot spring via this message board, but he never responded, and I'm worried he's gone missing. If anyone has any information about what might have happened to him, I would greatly appreciate it if you could let me know."

dialogues.speaker: Message From a Local
dialogues.text: "I've met him — I served as his guide a couple of days back. It seems like he's already set off back to Fontaine."

dialogues.speaker: Searcher's Response
dialogues.text: "Huh, gone already? And in such a hurry too... Did he mention... why?"

dialogues.speaker: Message From a Local
dialogues.text: "I think he might have been startled by something. He left in such a hurry, muttering something about 'dissolving'... Such a shame, especially given how few holidays they get..."
